A.name: A
A.query:
WITH
  series AS (
    SELECT fingerprint, any(if(JSONExtractString(labels, 'host.name') != '', JSONExtractString(labels, 'host.name'), JSONExtractString(labels, 'host.id'))) AS host
    FROM signoz_metrics.time_series_v4
    WHERE metric_name = 'loom.ci_telemetry.export_lag'
    GROUP BY fingerprint
  )
SELECT toStartOfInterval(toDateTime(intDiv(s.unix_milli, 1000)), INTERVAL 1 MINUTE) AS ts,
       series.host AS host,
       max(s.value) AS value
FROM signoz_metrics.samples_v4 AS s
INNER JOIN series USING (fingerprint)
WHERE s.metric_name = 'loom.ci_telemetry.export_lag'
  AND s.unix_milli >= {{.start_timestamp_ms}}
  AND s.unix_milli < {{.end_timestamp_ms}}
GROUP BY ts, host
ORDER BY ts

annotations.description: Host {{$labels.host}}: loom.ci_telemetry.export_lag has stayed above 7200 s (2 h) for every sample in the last 30 min, so the oldest CI journal line not yet exported is more than 2 h old. The poller is writing but the exporter is not draining its journal (the 2026-10-15 captain shape: cursor stuck at ~2.3 GB of a 4.9 GB journal). Lag is 0 when caught up or the journal is absent, and no point is emitted when the journal is unreadable, so this arm cannot fire on I/O error; ci-telemetry-arrival-silent is the backstop. Check `ci-telemetry status.json` and the export cursor. Issues #12908, #12792.
